text:
mika: Quick conv-stub: we need to pick one clear default for Dedicated commit + burst so customers aren't confused. Options: conservative (low burst), balanced (small soft buffer), aggressive (large soft burst).

devan: Customer input: two fintechs asked for balanced. They care about p95 latency and predictable bills.

sara: Runtime note: balanced = 10% headroom for 3 minutes/day free, then metered. Easy to enforce and low risk.

jules: Sales asks for a visible "burst_preview" on checkout so customers see estimated overage cost.

mika: Agreement: default -> balanced. Enterprise can opt into aggressive after safety review.

devan: API change: add "burst_profile": "conservative|balanced|aggressive" on the commitment POST. Backfill existing commitments to balanced.

sara: Ops: add alert when pool-level burst_usage > 20% for 5m. Also create playbook for spillover.

jules: I'll draft checkout copy and sample invoice lines for the UI.

ops-bot: Rolling deploy plan: feature-flag default=balanced; canary 5% traffic -> monitor for 2h.

mika: Next steps: devan + sara to spec API + alerts, jules to prepare UI text. We'll reconvene Wed to approve pilot list. Thanks :thumbsup:
